regionalModel: Metropolitan French reference; regional variants require review

lessons.title: Contrast nasal vowels with spoken n and m
lessons.objective: Hear a nasal vowel without a following nasal consonant in bon and nom, then compare the spoken n or m in bonne, une, and pomme.
lessons.focus: In bon and nom, the written n or m marks a nasal vowel without a final /n/ or /m/. In bonne and pomme, the consonant is spoken after an oral vowel. Compare un and une using one speaker model; the exact nasal vowel in un varies by region.

words.fr: Une pomme et un gâteau, s'il vous plaît.
words.en: An apple and a cake, please.

reader.fr: Au marché, une vendeuse propose un bon gâteau et une pomme.
reader.en: At the market, a vendor offers a good cake and an apple.

reader.fr: Je choisis une bonne pomme et je demande le prix du gâteau.
reader.en: I choose a good apple and ask the price of the cake.

reader.fr: Pour garder ma commande de côté, la vendeuse me demande mon nom.
reader.en: To set my order aside, the vendor asks for my name.

reader.fr: Je lui dis mon nom et elle répète : « Une pomme et un gâteau. »
reader.en: I tell her my name and she repeats, 'An apple and a cake.'

speaking.scene: Setting aside an order at a market stall
speaking.opening: Bonjour, je prends une bonne pomme et un gâteau.
goals: Order one apple and one cake.
Give your name for the held order.
Confirm that you chose the good apple.
speaking.closure: Merci, voici mon nom pour la commande.

see.prompt: Compare bon with bonne and nom with pomme: mark the nasal vowel or the spoken final /n/ or /m/; then read un and une.

recall.prompt: Recall the French phrase for 'a good apple' before revealing it.

hear.prompt: Listen for bon or bonne in the recorded market phrase.

type.prompt: Type the French question for 'What is your name?'

say.prompt: Order one apple and one cake from the vendor.
say.answerRef: Une pomme et un gâteau, s'il vous plaît.

write.prompt: Write two French sentences about the apple, the cake, and the name on the order.

lessons.title: Keep /pʁ/ and /bʁ/ together
lessons.objective: Produce French /pʁ/ and /bʁ/ in a tourist-office exchange without inserting a vowel between the consonants.
lessons.focus: Begin prix, prêt, and prendre with /pʁ/; begin bras, brochure, and bruit with /bʁ/. Move from the initial stop into the /ʁ/ of the same syllable, then continue into the word and phrase.

words.fr: Quel est le prix de la visite ?
words.en: What is the price of the tour?

words.fr: Je suis prêt à prendre la brochure.
words.en: I am ready to take the brochure.

words.fr: Je porte le sac sous le bras.
words.en: I carry the bag under my arm.

words.fr: Il y a du bruit dans la rue.
words.en: There is noise in the street.

reader.fr: À l'office de tourisme, je demande le prix d'une visite guidée.
reader.en: At the tourist office, I ask the price of a guided tour.

reader.fr: L'employée me tend une brochure, mais le bruit de la rue couvre sa voix.
reader.en: The employee hands me a brochure, but street noise covers her voice.

reader.fr: Je me rapproche, prêt à prendre la brochure et à écouter son explication.
reader.en: I move closer, ready to take the brochure and listen to her explanation.

reader.fr: Puis je glisse la brochure dans le sac que je porte sous le bras.
reader.en: Then I slip the brochure into the bag I carry under my arm.

speaking.scene: Asking about a guided tour at a tourist office
speaking.opening: Bonjour, quel est le prix de la visite ?
goals: Ask the price of a guided tour.
Request the brochure because street noise covered the answer.
Say you are ready to take the brochure.

see.prompt: Mark the /pʁ/ onset in prix, prêt, prendre and the /bʁ/ onset in bras, brochure, bruit.

recall.prompt: Recall the French question asking the price of the tour before revealing it.
recall.answerRef: Quel est le prix de la visite ?

hear.prompt: Listen for prix or bruit in the recorded tourist-office phrase.

type.prompt: Type the French sentence for 'There is noise in the street.'
type.answerRef: Il y a du bruit dans la rue.

say.prompt: Tell the employee you are ready to take the brochure.
say.answerRef: Je suis prêt à prendre la brochure.

write.prompt: Write two French sentences about the tour price and the brochure despite street noise.

lessons.title: Join /tʁ/ and /dʁ/ in directions
lessons.objective: Move from French /t/ or /d/ into /ʁ/ in useful station words and a direction request.
lessons.focus: Keep /tʁ/ together in train, trois, and trajet; compare /dʁ/ at the start of droit and drapeau and inside adresse. Do not insert a vowel between the consonants.

words.fr: Le train part dans trois minutes.
words.en: The train leaves in three minutes.

words.fr: Allez tout droit vers le drapeau bleu.
words.en: Go straight toward the blue flag.

reader.fr: À la gare, je vérifie l'adresse du lieu de rendez-vous.
reader.en: At the station, I check the address of the meeting place.

reader.fr: Trois trains sont annoncés, mais un seul suit le trajet direct.
reader.en: Three trains are announced, but only one takes the direct route.

reader.fr: Un agent me dit d'aller tout droit vers le drapeau bleu près du quai.
reader.en: A staff member tells me to go straight toward the blue flag near the platform.

reader.fr: Je trouve le bon train et je monte avant le départ.
reader.en: I find the right train and board before departure.

speaking.scene: Finding a direct train by a marked platform
speaking.opening: Bonjour, je cherche le train pour ce trajet direct.
goals: Ask which of the three trains takes the direct route.
Ask whether to walk straight toward the blue flag.
speaking.closure: Merci, je vais tout droit vers le bon train.

see.prompt: Group train, trois, trajet by /tʁ/ and droit, drapeau, adresse by /dʁ/; find the cluster's place in each word.

recall.prompt: Recall the French phrase meaning 'go straight toward the blue flag' before revealing it.
recall.answerRef: Allez tout droit vers le drapeau bleu.

hear.prompt: Listen for train or drapeau in the recorded station phrase.

type.prompt: Type the French sentence for 'The train leaves in three minutes.'
type.answerRef: Le train part dans trois minutes.

say.prompt: Tell the attendant you have the station's address.

write.prompt: Write two French sentences identifying the direct route and the blue flag near the platform.
